title: You need these ugly facebook ads 🤮
description: You need these ugly facebook ads 🤮
transcript: If you run Facebook ads, you need to start making uglier ads. These three ads. They've each run for hundreds of days straight, and they consistently pull a 3 x return ad spend on meta. Here's why. Because they don't look like ads. They look real. They look native. They look like something your aunt would post on Facebook. Simple testimonial photo. A basic product shot with a gray background. A raw, unpolished lifestyle image. No fancy edits, no high end studio and no agency gloss. Sometimes the ugly ads convert the most. So stop trying to win a design award and start trying to sell comment ugly and I'll show you how to make ads like this that generate consistent 3 x return ad spends.
